description: Scheduled flights between two airports on a day. Between Taiwan airports: the domestic flights of Mandarin Airlines, UNI Air and Daily Air with cancellations and fares in NT$. To or from abroad: the published international timetable, code-share numbers grouped under one flight. Use flight_status or flight_board for live status. Example: from "松山", to "金門", date "2026-11-02"; or from "TPE", to "NRT".

after.description: Only departures at or after this time, HH:mm (default: now for today, else 00:00).

date.description: Travel date in Taiwan, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today).

from.description: Departure airport: a Taiwan airport (TPE, 松山, 金門) or any IATA code or name abroad (NRT, HND, Tokyo).

limit.description: Maximum number of flights to return (default 20).

to.description: Arrival airport: a Taiwan airport (TSA, 高雄) or any IATA code or name abroad (HKG, Osaka).

name: flight_schedule
title: Flight schedule
